REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS ATLANTA, GEORGIA, October 21, 2026: Rollins, Inc. (NYSE:ROL) (“Rollins” or the “Company”), a premier global consumer and commercial services company, reported unaudited financial results for the third quarter of 2026. Key Highlights • Third quarter revenues were $1.1 billion, an increase of 6.2% over the third quarter of 2025 with organic revenues* increasing 4.4% compared to the prior year. • Quarterly operating income was $223 million, a decrease of 1.0% compared to the third quarter of 2025. Quarterly operating margin was 20.5%, a decrease of 140 basis points compared to the third quarter of 2025. Adjusted operating income* was $231 million, a decrease of 0.6% versus the prior year. Adjusted operating margin* was 21.2%, a decrease of 140 basis points compared to the prior year. • Quarterly net income was $158 million, a decrease of 3.4% compared to the prior year. Adjusted net income* was $163 million, a decrease of 3.1% versus the prior year. • Adjusted EBITDA* was $257 million, a decrease of 0.7% compared to the prior year. Adjusted EBITDA margin* was 23.5%, a decrease of 170 basis points versus the third quarter of 2025. • Quarterly EPS was $0.33 per diluted share, a 2.9% decrease compared to the prior year. Adjusted EPS* was $0.34 per diluted share, a decrease of 2.9% versus the prior year. • Operating cash flow was $242 million for the quarter, an increase of 26.4% compared to the prior year. Free cash flow* was $235 million for the quarter, an increase of 28.8% compared to the prior year. Cash flow was favorably impacted by $63 million due to the timing of a tax refund associated with our tax credit planning strategy. The Company invested $27 million in acquisitions, $6 million in capital expenditures, $120 million in share repurchases, and paid dividends totaling $87 million. *Amounts are non-GAAP financial measures. See the appendix to this release below for a discussion of non-GAAP financial metrics including a reconciliation to the most directly comparable GAAP measure. Management Commentary "We are disappointed with our third quarter performance and are acting with urgency to address the challenges impacting our results. We now have a clearer understanding of how the customer acquisition landscape is evolving and are taking concrete steps to optimize our approach. This remains a dynamic environment that requires us to continually assess and adapt how we reach and win new customers. At the same time, our record of 100 consecutive quarters of revenue growth reflects the durability of our business and our ability to successfully adapt through changing conditions. With recurring customer relationships, a diversified portfolio and the underlying resilience of the pest control market, we remain confident in our ability to deliver sustainable, profitable growth over the long term,” said Jerry Gahlhoff, Jr., President and Chief Executive Officer. "Residential customer acquisition remained under pressure in the third quarter. We are responding with a more dynamic marketing approach—reallocating resources from the traditional digital playbook to the channels and capabilities generating the highest returns, including those that strengthen our visibility in AI- and LLM-driven discovery. Our capital allocation priorities remain unchanged: investing in the business through accretive M&A, maintaining and growing a healthy and sustainable dividend, and deploying excess cash opportunistically for share repurchases. Our financial flexibility and conviction in the intrinsic value of the business supported more meaningful share repurchase activity during the quarter. At the same time, we continue to invest in our people and the service quality that builds customer loyalty,” said Will Harkins, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. 1 Three and Nine Months Ended Financial Highlights Three Months Ended September 30, Nine Months Ended September 30, Variance Variance (unaudited, in thousands, except per share data and margins) 2026 2025 $ % 2026 2025 $ % GAAP Metrics Revenues $ 1,089,670 $ 1,026,106 $ 63,564 6.2 % $ 3,074,670 $ 2,848,137 $ 226,533 8.0 % Gross profit (1) $ 582,903 $ 558,656 $ 24,247 4.3 % $ 1,613,751 $ 1,518,692 $ 95,059 6.3 % Gross profit margin (1) 53.5 % 54.4 % (90) bps 52.5 % 53.3 % (80) bps Operating income $ 222,859 $ 225,021 $ (2,162) (1.0) % $ 569,704 $ 566,002 $ 3,702 0.7 % Operating margin 20.5 % 21.9 % (140) bps 18.5 % 19.9 % (140) bps Net income $ 157,927 $ 163,527 $ (5,600) (3.4) % $ 409,675 $ 410,264 $ (589) (0.1) % EPS $ 0.33 $ 0.34 $ (0.01) (2.9) % $ 0.85 $ 0.85 $ — — % Net cash provided by operating activities $ 241,859 $ 191,349 $ 50,510 26.4 % $ 532,732 $ 513,363 $ 19,369 3.8 % Non-GAAP Metrics Adjusted operating income (2) $ 230,683 $ 232,057 $ (1,374) (0.6) % $ 593,415 $ 584,826 $ 8,589 1.5 % Adjusted operating margin (2) 21.2 % 22.6 % (140) bps 19.3 % 20.5 % (120) bps Adjusted net income (2) $ 163,343 $ 168,501 $ (5,158) (3.1) % $ 428,499 $ 423,277 $ 5,222 1.2 % Adjusted EPS (2) $ 0.34 $ 0.35 $ (0.01) (2.9) % $ 0.89 $ 0.87 $ 0.02 2.3 % Adjusted EBITDA (2) $ 256,571 $ 258,334 $ (1,763) (0.7) % $ 672,332 $ 661,343 $ 10,989 1.7 % Adjusted EBITDA margin (2) 23.5 % 25.2 % (170) bps 21.9 % 23.2 % (130) bps Free cash flow (2) $ 235,495 $ 182,846 $ 52,649 28.8 % $ 512,800 $ 491,003 $ 21,797 4.4 % (1) Exclusive of depreciation and amortization (2) Amounts are non-GAAP financial measures. (ROL) is a premier global consumer and commercial services company. Through its family of leading brands, the Company and its franchises provide essential pest control services and protection against termite damage, rodents, and insects to more than 2.8 million customers in North America, South America, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Australia, with approximately 22,000 employees from more than 850 locations. Rollins is parent to numerous brands, including Aardwolf Pestkare, Clark Pest Control, Crane Pest Control, Critter Control, Fox Pest Control, HomeTeam Pest Defense, Industrial Fumigant Company, MissQuito, Northwest Exterminating, OPC Pest Services, Orkin, Orkin Australia, Orkin Canada, Orkin UK, Safeguard, Romex Pest Control, Saela Pest Control, Trutech, Waltham Services, and Western Pest Services. You can learn more about Rollins and its subsidiaries by visiting www.rollins.com . reference.summary: Rollins, Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides pest and wildlife control services and protection to residential and commercial customers in the United States and internationally. The company offers pest control services to residential properties protecting from common pests, including rodents, insects, and wildlife. It also provides workplace pest control solutions for customers across various end markets, such as healthcare, food service, and logistics. In addition, the company offers termite protection and ancillary services for both residential and commercial customers. It serves clients directly, as well as through franchisee operations. The company was formerly known as Rollins Broadcasting, Inc and changed its name to Rollins, Inc. in 1965. Rollins, Inc. was founded in 1901 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
